summary: Displays a saved payment method using masked data only.
whenToUse: Listing a payment method with brand, last four digits and expiration date.
whenNotToUse: Collecting card data or processing payments.

keyboard.action: Reaches and activates the available actions.

accessibility: Actions are native design system buttons.
The interface shows only the last four digits; it does not accept full card data.
responsive: Details and actions wrap in narrow containers.
commonMistakes: Passing or requesting the PAN, CVV or other full card data.
limits: Does not store or process payment data.
